description: This source file implements compatibility checks related to filesystem monitoring in Git, specifically checking for virtual filesystem support on Windows (VFS for Git). It contains functions to determine if the repository's configuration indicates incompatibility with FSMonitor based on VFS settings.

methods.name: enum:fsmonitor_reason check_vfs4git(struct repository * r)
methods.description: Checks if the repository has VFS for Git enabled via its configuration. Returns FSMONITOR_REASON_VFS4GIT if virtual filesystem is enabled, otherwise FSMONITOR_REASON_OK.

methods.name: enum:fsmonitor_reason fsm_os__incompatible(struct repository * r,int ipc UNUSED)
methods.description: Determines if the repository is incompatible with FSMonitor considering VFS support, utilizing check_vfs4git function.

ctags.name: fsm_os__incompatible
ctags.pattern: /^enum fsmonitor_reason fsm_os__incompatible(struct repository *r, int ipc UNUSED)$/
